data.name: Verdant Resistance
data.description: A verdant companion gains a +%1 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep effects, and stunning.|VerdantCompanionResistanceBonus

raw_tokens.value: A verdant companion gains a +%1 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep effects, and stunning.|VerdantCompanionResistanceBonus

A verdant companion gains roots it can plant or retract as a swift action. With its roots planted, it can't move, but it gains a +4 bonus to its CMD against bull rush, pull, push, reposition, trip, and other combat maneuvers that would knock it over or move it.|PREVARGTEQ:MasterLevel,6
